name: Cold-chain pharmaceutical (2-8 C)
sources: WHO Technical Report Series 961 Annex 9 (2011): storage and transport of time- and temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical products; 2-8 C labelled range.
USP <1079> Good Storage and Distribution Practices: cumulative excursion (MKT / time-out-of-refrigeration) budgeting.
Sample budget of 12 h cumulative out-of-range time is illustrative; real products carry a manufacturer-specified stability budget.
